I count roughly 12 to 15 pieces. Each piece weighs about 8 to 10 g, which puts the total near 110 to 130 g. I'll use 120 g.

Cooked carrots with a glaze run about 0.4 to 0.6 kcal/g. At 0.5 kcal/g, 120 g comes to about 60 kcal. The glossy look suggests some butter or glaze, so I'll raise that to about 70 kcal.
